tradition.description: The traditional Chinese calendrical and cosmological system combining the Ten Heavenly Stems (天干 Tiāngān) and Twelve Earthly Branches (地支 Dìzhī) into the sixty-year Ganzhi cycle. Used for Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi) astrology, year/month/day/hour animal signs, and elemental analysis. Integrates Wu Xing (Five Phases) and Yin-Yang polarity.
